title: You Don't Need a Crystal Ball

sentences.zh: 这里是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。
我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: On January 28, 1986, the Challenger spacecraft blasted off from Cape Canaveral.
sentences.zh: 1986年1月28日，“挑战者号”航天飞机从卡纳维拉尔角发射升空。

sentences.en: Liftoff of the 25th Space Shuttle mission, and it has cleared the tower.
sentences.zh: 第25次航天飞机任务顺利升空，已飞离发射塔。

sentences.en: Seconds after liftoff into a clear blue sky, something went wrong.
sentences.zh: 在升空进入晴朗蓝天几秒后，情况出现了异常。

sentences.en: Flight controllers here looking very carefully at the situation.
sentences.zh: 飞行控制中心正在非常仔细地观察局势。

sentences.en: It was much more than a malfunction.
As millions of people watched in horror, trails of smoke and debris flew off in different directions.
sentences.zh: 在数百万人的惊恐注视下，烟雾和碎片向四面八方飞散。

sentences.en: We have a report from the flight dynamics officer that the vehicle has exploded.
sentences.zh: 我们收到飞行动力官员的报告，航天飞机已经爆炸。

sentences.en: Those words flashing across America today.
sentences.zh: 这些字眼今天传遍了全美。

sentences.en: The Challenger exploded this morning just after liftoff from Cape Canaveral.
sentences.zh: “挑战者号”今天早上在从卡纳维拉尔角升空后不久就发生了爆炸。

sentences.en: The crew of seven now presumed dead.
sentences.zh: 机上七名机组人员现已被推定遇难。

sentences.en: After the explosion, NASA officials were hauled to Capitol Hill and put to questioning.
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生后，NASA官员被传唤到国会山接受质询。

sentences.en: Who finally made that decision to go?
sentences.zh: 到底是谁最终做出了发射的决定？
各个环节是如何关联的？

sentences.en: Members of Congress asked the tough questions.
sentences.zh: 国会议员们提出了尖锐的问题。

sentences.en: These are the kinds of questions we have when any catastrophe occurs.
sentences.zh: 每当灾难发生时，我们都会产生这类疑问。

sentences.en: Whether a spacecraft has exploded, a new war has broken out, or the world is swept up in a fast-moving pandemic.
sentences.zh: 无论是航天飞机爆炸、新战争爆发，还是全球陷入一场快速蔓延的疫情。

sentences.en: In all these cases, we want to know, who screwed up?
sentences.zh: 在所有这些情况下，我们都想知道：是谁搞砸了？
你们的政府辜负了你们。

sentences.en: Those entrusted with protecting you failed you.
sentences.zh: 那些受托保护你们的人辜负了你们。

sentences.en: The State Department had received repeated warnings that the situation was getting worse.
sentences.zh: 国务院曾多次收到警告，称局势正在恶化。

sentences.en: And we try to figure out how...
How do we make sure that this kind of breach...
sentences.zh: 我们如何确保这种漏洞……

sentences.en: With many of these incidents, there's a sense that they could have been avoided.
sentences.zh: 对于许多此类事件，人们总觉得它们本是可以避免的。

sentences.en: That someone knew something, but didn't say anything.
sentences.zh: 总觉得有人知道些什么，却什么也没说。

sentences.en: Or if they said it, they weren't believed.
sentences.zh: 或者即使说了，也没人相信。

sentences.en: Or if they were believed, nothing was done.
sentences.zh: 或者即使相信了，也没有采取任何行动。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we revisit a favorite 2019 episode about the psychology of warnings
sentences.zh: 本周在《隐藏的大脑》节目中，我们将重温2019年一期关于警告心理学的热门节目，

sentences.en: and how we can all become better at predicting the future.
sentences.zh: 探讨我们如何才能更好地预测未来。
为什么有些警告会被听取。
为什么许多警告被忽视。

sentences.en: And the pitfalls of being a prophet.
We begin this tale of warnings made and warnings ignored in the middle of Alaska.
sentences.zh: 我们从阿拉斯加中部开始讲述这个关于警告与忽视的故事。

sentences.en: It's a balmy day, barely jacket weather.
sentences.zh: 那是一个温暖的日子，几乎不需要穿外套。

sentences.en: I'm in a car riding on a weather-beaten road that leads out of Fairbanks.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在一辆车里，行驶在费尔班克斯郊外一条饱经风霜的公路上。

sentences.en: Chris Heimstra is driving, and he points out something.
sentences.zh: 克里斯·海姆斯塔（Chris Heimstra）正在开车，他指出了一个现象。

sentences.en: And you can see in the road here, you see all these bumps and all these curves.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到路面上，到处都是凸起和弯道。
这些可不是普通的坑洼。

sentences.en: The state of the road is a sign of something far more significant.
sentences.zh: 路面的状况预示着更严重的问题。

sentences.en: Beneath the pavement, the ground is disintegrating.
sentences.zh: 在路面之下，地面正在瓦解。

sentences.en: What lies below the asphalt is the Alaskan permafrost, and it's melting.
sentences.zh: 沥青下面是阿拉斯加的永久冻土，而且它正在融化。

sentences.en: Permafrost is any soil or ice or rock that's frozen for more than two years, like two consecutive years.
sentences.zh: 永久冻土是指任何冻结时间超过两年的土壤、冰或岩石，比如连续两年。

sentences.en: Picture the plants and animals that lived in Alaska over the past tens of thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 想象一下过去几万年来生活在阿拉斯加的动植物。

sentences.en: After they died and fell to the ground, they froze.
sentences.zh: 它们死后倒在地上，然后被冻住了。

sentences.en: Permafrost is made up of layer upon layer of this organic frozen material.
sentences.zh: 永久冻土就是由一层又一层这种冷冻的有机物质构成的。

sentences.en: There's a place where you can see what's happening deep inside this permafroSt.
sentences.zh: 有一个地方可以看到永久冻土深处正在发生什么。

sentences.en: It's a tunnel that's hundreds of feet long.
sentences.zh: 那是一条长达数百英尺的隧道。

sentences.en: It's built into the side of an Alaskan hill.
sentences.zh: 它建在阿拉斯加的一座山坡里。

sentences.en: Chris is a research scientist at the Army Corps of Engineers.
sentences.zh: 克里斯是陆军工程兵团的一名研究科学家。

sentences.en: He works in the Cold Regions Research and Engineering Laboratory out of Fairbanks.
sentences.zh: 他在费尔班克斯的寒区研究与工程实验室工作。

sentences.en: He has spent a lot of time in this tunnel, and he's taking me there today to show me something important.
sentences.zh: 他在这个隧道里花了很多时间，今天他带我来这里，是为了向我展示一些重要的事情。

sentences.en: There's 40,000 years of Earth history that's stored and frozen in time.
sentences.zh: 这里储存并冻结了地球4万年的历史。

sentences.en: To get to that frozen history, we walk through a set of gates, over to a wood cabin, a whole bunch of hardhats.
sentences.zh: 为了进入那段冰封的历史，我们穿过几道门，走到一个木屋前，那里放着一堆安全帽。

sentences.en: We head over to what looks like a nondescript wooden shed.
sentences.zh: 我们走向一个看起来不起眼的木棚。

sentences.en: It has a sign on the outside that says, U.S.
sentences.zh: 外面挂着一个牌子，写着“美国”。

sentences.en: Army Corps of Engineers, and a warning to watch your step.
sentences.zh: 陆军工程兵团，还有一个提醒你注意脚下的警告。

sentences.en: At the far end, there's another door that leads into the actual tunnel.
sentences.zh: 在尽头，有另一扇门通往真正的隧道。

sentences.en: Chris turns on the lights and leads me through.
sentences.zh: 克里斯打开灯，带我走了进去。

sentences.en: We walk down to a lower area.
sentences.zh: 我们走到一个更低的区域。

sentences.en: The lower down you go into the tunnel, the older you are in sediment.
sentences.zh: 你在隧道里走得越深，沉积物的年代就越久远。

sentences.en: The further back we move in time.
Okay, so like back over here...
When Chris describes what's in the tunnel, he's even-toned.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯描述隧道里的东西时，他的语气很平静。

sentences.en: But what I can see all around me is completely extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 但我周围所看到的一切却完全非同寻常。

sentences.en: Yeah, so on that, that's like a 43,000-year-old piece of probably willow that's been sitting down here for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 是的，你看那个，那是一块大约43000年前的柳木碎片，可能在这里待了很久了。

sentences.en: It actually looks like it could have fallen last year.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是去年才掉落的一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's amazing the cold temperatures and how long it can be, organic matter can be preserved here.
sentences.zh: 是的，低温能让有机物质保存这么久，真是太神奇了。

sentences.en: If you're picturing this like a real-life trip on the magic school bus, you're right.
sentences.zh: 如果你把这想象成现实版的《神奇校车》之旅，你是对的。

sentences.en: Except, there's one part of the experience that doesn't exactly fill me with wonder.
sentences.zh: 只不过，这段经历中有一部分并不能让我感到惊奇。

sentences.en: I think the aroma is one thing that people notice right away.
sentences.zh: 我想气味是人们第一时间注意到的东西。

sentences.en: I was just going to ask you, is it just me or does this place stink?
sentences.zh: 我正想问你，是只有我这么觉得，还是这地方真的很臭？

sentences.en: It's definitely got an unusual smell and that's your organic matter that's coming back into the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 它确实有一种不同寻常的味道，那是你的有机物质正在重新回到大气中。

sentences.en: All around me, the decaying plants and animals smell like food gone bad in a freezer.
sentences.zh: 我周围腐烂的动植物闻起来就像冰箱里变质的食物。

sentences.en: But what it ought to be is terrifying.
sentences.zh: 但它本该让人感到恐惧。

sentences.en: Something is happening here that has consequences for the entire planet.
sentences.zh: 这里正在发生的事情对整个地球都有影响。

sentences.en: The organic matter trapped in the permafrost, fungi, plants, animals, it's thawing.
sentences.zh: 困在永久冻土里的有机物质，真菌、植物、动物，正在解冻。
当它们解冻时，就会腐烂。

sentences.en: And as it decays, it releases extraordinary amounts of carbon into the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 而当它们腐烂时，会向大气中释放出惊人的碳。

sentences.en: Scientists say the amount of carbon that's stored in the permafrost is about double of what's in the entire atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 科学家说，永久冻土中储存的碳量大约是整个大气中碳含量的两倍。

sentences.en: What happens if that temperature goes up or for some reason it thaws a little bit more?
sentences.zh: 如果温度升高，或者由于某种原因它进一步融化了会怎样？

sentences.en: A place you don't necessarily want it is back in the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 你肯定不希望它回到大气中。

sentences.en: We don't want it back in the atmosphere because carbon dioxide contributes to climate change.
sentences.zh: 我们不希望它回到大气中，因为二氧化碳会导致气候变化。

sentences.en: But a vicious cycle has already started.
sentences.zh: 但一个恶性循环已经开始了。

sentences.en: As the planet warms, the permafrost thaws.
sentences.zh: 随着地球变暖，永久冻土融化。

sentences.en: All those dead animals and plants and fungi start to decompose.
sentences.zh: 所有那些死去的动物、植物和真菌开始分解。

sentences.en: More decomposition means more carbon released into the atmosphere,
sentences.zh: 分解越多，释放到大气中的碳就越多，

sentences.en: which means warmer temperatures, which means even more melting in the permafroSt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着温度更高，意味着永久冻土融化得更多。

sentences.en: The firestorm in Australia has burned an area as large as West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的火灾烧毁的面积相当于整个西弗吉尼亚州。

sentences.en: So it started raining and no big deal.
sentences.zh: 当时开始下雨了，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: And then we see the water going down the street start to get a little bit higher.
sentences.zh: 然后我们看到街上的水开始涨高了一点。

sentences.en: At the rate global temperatures are rising, 60% of all the glaciers here in Xinjiang,
sentences.zh: 按照全球气温上升的速度，新疆这里60%的冰川，

sentences.en: nearly 11,000 glaciers, will be gone within 50 years.
sentences.zh: 近11000座冰川，将在50年内消失。

sentences.en: Chris doesn't need to turn on the news to see what rising temperatures are doing to the planet.
sentences.zh: 克里斯不需要看新闻就能知道气温上升对地球的影响。

sentences.en: When he's in the tunnel, he can see it right in front of his eyes.
sentences.zh: 当他在隧道里时，他能亲眼看到。

sentences.en: He's reminded of it every time he drives on the cracked pavement.
sentences.zh: 每次他开车经过开裂的路面时，都会想起这一点。

sentences.en: And there's a feeling that he can't escape.
sentences.zh: 而且有一种他无法逃避的感觉。

sentences.en: It comes when he's at work, when he talks to strangers,
sentences.zh: 这种感觉在他工作时、与陌生人交谈时，

sentences.en: even when he's in the comfort of his own car.
sentences.zh: 甚至在他坐在舒适的车里时都会出现。

sentences.en: He can see a catastrophe unfolding in front of him,
sentences.zh: 他能看到一场灾难正在他面前展开，

sentences.en: but no one seems to be listening.
sentences.zh: 但似乎没有人愿意倾听。

sentences.en: Or people seem to be worried about the wrong things,
sentences.zh: 或者人们似乎在担心错误的事情，

sentences.en: like in a conversation he had earlier in the day.
sentences.zh: 就像他今天早些时候的一次谈话一样。

sentences.en: The claim was made that most of the CO2 in the atmosphere comes from volcanoes,
sentences.zh: 有人声称大气中大部分二氧化碳来自火山，

sentences.en: It was somebody on the school field trip earlier today.
sentences.zh: 是今天早些时候学校实地考察时的一个人。

sentences.en: And I pushed back against that politely.
sentences.zh: 我礼貌地反驳了这一点。

sentences.en: And it's hard because you've got to be really...
sentences.zh: 这很难，因为你必须非常……

sentences.en: You don't want to offend people.
Because making someone angry isn't going to change their mind at all.
sentences.zh: 因为让别人生气根本改变不了他们的想法。

sentences.en: So you've got to be really careful about how you wade into things.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须非常小心地处理这些事情。

sentences.en: And you don't know this person necessarily.
sentences.zh: 而且你不一定认识这个人。

sentences.en: And there's not a familial tie.
All we have really in common is that our kids go to the same school
sentences.zh: 我们真正共同点只是我们的孩子在同一所学校，

sentences.en: and they're in the same class.
But it was a crucial piece of misinformation that wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 但那是一个至关重要的错误信息，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And then, so what do you just say, like, flat out, like, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 那么，你该直接说“那不是真的”吗？

sentences.en: That's going to shut everything down.
sentences.zh: 那会把一切谈话都终结。

sentences.en: And it's not going to help me in any way.
sentences.zh: 而且对我没有任何帮助。

sentences.en: It's just going to make somebody who thinks I'm a jerk.
sentences.zh: 只会让别人觉得我是个混蛋。

sentences.en: To Chris, it seems as if the pushback he gets is driven by a larger contempt
sentences.zh: 对克里斯来说，他所受到的抵触似乎是由一种更广泛的蔑视所驱动的。

sentences.en: that some people feel towards science and scientists.
sentences.zh: 有些人对科学和科学家所持有的那种态度。

sentences.en: Like, it's not relegated or limited to your work.
sentences.zh: 这并非仅仅局限于你的工作。

sentences.en: It's a critique of you as a person,
sentences.zh: 这是对你个人的人格批判，

sentences.en: as if, like, you're just trying to lie to people about the work you do,
sentences.zh: 就好像你在对自己所从事的工作撒谎一样，

sentences.en: I mean, your stock as a scientist is because of your honesty.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你作为科学家的价值正是源于你的诚实。

sentences.en: If you're not honest as a scientist, your career is over.
sentences.zh: 如果你作为科学家不诚实，你的职业生涯就完了。

sentences.en: He walks in a remote place, 40 feet below the surface,
sentences.zh: 他走在一个偏远的地方，在地表下40英尺处，

sentences.en: in a part of the country that's unfamiliar to most Americans.
sentences.zh: 位于大多数美国人都不熟悉的国土区域。

sentences.en: A lot of them will never make it up here.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人永远不会来到这里。

sentences.en: A lot of them won't go into the permafrost tunnel.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人不会进入永久冻土隧道。

sentences.en: A lot of them won't go run up above the tunnel or throughout Alaska
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人不会去隧道上方或整个阿拉斯加地区，

sentences.en: where permafrost exists or even understand what it looks like,
sentences.zh: 去看看永久冻土存在的地方，甚至不了解它看起来是什么样，

sentences.en: So, how do you communicate that?
sentences.zh: 那么，你该如何传达这一点呢？

sentences.en: How do you say, like, there's a value in you understanding
sentences.zh: 你该如何表达，去理解那些
你目前尚不理解的事物是有价值的？

sentences.en: How do you get people to see that there's value in understanding
sentences.zh: 你该如何让人们看到，去理解那些
他们不理解的事物是有价值的？

sentences.en: Chris's question is an ancient question.
sentences.zh: 克里斯的问题是一个古老的问题。

sentences.en: For millennia, we've often shunned and shamed people
sentences.zh: 几千年来，我们常常排斥并羞辱那些

sentences.en: who have warned us of looming disaster.
sentences.zh: 警告我们大难临头的人。

sentences.en: Why do human beings who care about their survival
sentences.zh: 为什么关心自身生存的人类
却对末日的警告置若罔闻？

sentences.en: When we come back, we're going to do something unusual.
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，我们将做一件不同寻常的事。

sentences.en: We're going to look for answers to that question,
sentences.zh: 我们将去寻找这个问题的答案，

sentences.en: not in science, but in literature.
sentences.zh: 不是在科学中，而是在文学中。

sentences.en: We're going to dive into Greek mythology
sentences.zh: 我们将深入探讨希腊神话，

sentences.en: and talk about a doomed prophet.
sentences.zh: 谈谈一位注定悲剧的先知。

sentences.en: The lessons from her story still resonate today.
sentences.zh: 她故事中的教训在今天依然引起共鸣。
您正在收听的是《隐藏的大脑》（Hidden Brain）。
我是尚卡尔·维丹塔姆（Shankar Vedantam）。

sentences.en: In Greek mythology, the gods loom large.
sentences.zh: 在希腊神话中，众神的影响力巨大。

sentences.en: So large that many of them fill our imaginations even today.
sentences.zh: 大到即使在今天，他们中的许多人依然占据着我们的想象力。
爱与美的女神阿佛洛狄忒。

sentences.en: Hades in charge of the underworld.
The gods of ancient Greece moved among humans.
sentences.zh: 古希腊的众神行走在人类中间。

sentences.en: Some of those humans were themselves touched
sentences.zh: 其中一些人类本身也触碰到了

sentences.en: One of the most striking was the prophet Cassandra.
sentences.zh: 最引人注目的之一就是先知卡珊德拉。
卡珊德拉令人印象深刻，

sentences.en: that her story has inspired movies,
sentences.zh: 以至于她的故事激发了电影、
电视，甚至通俗流行音乐的创作灵感。

sentences.en: dedicated a song to her more than 2,500 years
sentences.zh: 为她创作了一首歌，这距离她最初被
荷马、埃斯库罗斯和欧里庇得斯
记录下来已经过去了2500多年。

sentences.en: This power that Cassandra had was incredible.
sentences.zh: 卡珊德拉拥有的这种力量令人难以置信。

sentences.en: It's not Cassandra's fault that she's not believed.
sentences.zh: 不被相信并不是卡珊德拉的错。
这位是艾米丽·威尔逊（Emily Wilson）。

sentences.en: I'm a professor of classical studies

sentences.zh: 任教于宾夕法尼亚大学。

sentences.en: Emily is going to take us back
to the legend of the kingdom of Troy.
She's going to help us understand
what this ancient myth still has to teach us.
sentences.zh: 这个古老的神话至今能教给我们什么。
